definitions.explanation: separating something into its component parts
breaking down into simpler substances through chemical or biological processes

examples.japanese: {時計|とけい}を{分解|ぶんかい}して{修理|しゅうり}した。
examples.english: I disassembled the watch and repaired it.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、おもちゃを{分解|ぶんかい}するのが{好|す}きだった。
examples.english: When I was a child, I liked taking toys apart.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{分解|ぶんかい}しやすい{設計|せっけい}だ。
examples.english: This product is designed to be easy to disassemble.

examples.japanese: {有機物|ゆうきぶつ}が{微生物|びせいぶつ}によって{分解|ぶんかい}される。
examples.english: Organic matter is decomposed by microorganisms.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}は{電気|でんき}{分解|ぶんかい}で{水素|すいそ}と{酸素|さんそ}に{分|わ}かれる。
examples.english: Water is separated into hydrogen and oxygen through electrolysis.

examples.japanese: プラスチックは{分解|ぶんかい}されにくい。

notes:
FORMATION:
{分|ぶん} (divide) + {解|かい} (dissolve, break apart) → divide and break apart

VERB FORM:
{分解|ぶんかい}する (to disassemble, to decompose)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {電気|でんき}{分解|ぶんかい} (electrolysis)
- {熱|ねつ}{分解|ぶんかい} (thermal decomposition)
- {生|せい}{分解|ぶんかい} (biodegradation)
- {分解|ぶんかい}{図|ず} (exploded diagram)

ANTONYM:
{組|く}み{立|た}て / {組立|くみたて} (assembly)

RELATED WORDS:
- {解体|かいたい} (dismantling - larger scale)
- {崩壊|ほうかい} (collapse, disintegration)
- {腐敗|ふはい} (decay, rotting)
